study.population: men, T2DM >3y, with peripheral neuropathy, HbA1c 6.6-12%
study.note_is: 全文无 HOMA/Matsuda/clamp/euglycemic；'insulin sensitivity' 仅出现在引言与讨论叙述中，无数据

missing_for_our_meta.post_intervention_FPG: 未报告（Table 3 仅基线 FBG）
missing_for_our_meta.fasting_insulin_cpeptide: Assay described in Methods 2.8 (electrochemiluminescence, Elecsys 2010, Cobas) but NO insulin value reported in any table; no post-intervention FPG/BMI/HDL-C/TG either
missing_for_our_meta.consequence: Cannot recompute, cannot adjust, cannot derive DI. Correction 2026-10-24: earlier note said 'no insulin assay performed' — that was wrong; an assay is described but its values never enter any reported outcome. The defect is severed provenance, not a missing measurement.

verdict.usable_as: 教科书级反例 —— 关系统计构造层(H2)的证据，不入任何合并
verdict.reason: 三个'主要结局'全部是 FPG/BMI/HDL-C/TG/age 的解析函数；分泌量从未被测量。报告值与'FPG 下降 1 mmol/L'引起的数学位移量级相当，构成同义反复(tautology)。且其相关分析'ΔFPIS vs ΔFBG r=-0.59' 因 FPIS 定义含 -0.119×FPG 而循环。

correction_20261024.what_changed: The assertion 'no insulin or C-peptide assay appears anywhere in the paper' was false as written and has been withdrawn from the manuscript (v3.9).
correction_20261024.evidence: Methods 2.8: 'Insulin concentrations were measured by electrochemiluminescence immunoassay on an Elecsys 2010 analyzer (Cobas, Roche Diagnostics, Germany).'
correction_20261024.accurate_statement: An insulin assay is described, but no measured insulin value reaches any reported outcome: all three primary outcomes are closed-form functions of fasting covariates, and no post-intervention covariate values are given.
correction_20261024.also_noted: The three outcomes are attributed to three different claimed methods in the same section (FPIS: repeated IVGTT; SPIS: modified low-dose glucose infusion test; GE: repeated IVGTT), with no data from any.
correction_20261024.correction_scope: Abstract bullet, Results sentence, and section 3.6 of the manuscript; plus the section 2.5 classification criterion (reported outcome, not assay method).
